faqs.a:
The city manager or their designee has the authority to close one or more city facilities
               to protect the safety of city employees and residents. In the event of a facility
               closure, employee compensation will be determined in accordance with a policy established
               by the city manager.
(
Ord. No. 4862
, § 1, 10-16-2023)
